annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1559/2024 - Altera a Lei nº 9.394/1996 (LDB) para vedar o uso de inteligência artificial como parâmetro de referência e métrica para material pedagógico e avaliação de desempenho escolar
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1559/2024 - Amending the National Education Guidelines and Framework Law to prohibit use of artificial intelligence as a reference and metric for teaching materials and school performance assessment
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Professora Luciene Cavalcante, Câmara dos Deputados (Brazil)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill amending the Education Guidelines and Framework Law to ban use of AI-generated content as a reference or metric for public-school teaching materials and for performance assessment. It limits AI to optional teacher-supervised research support and requires the Ministry of Education to ensure secure AI with privacy by design.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bans AI or media-platform content as reference/metric for public-school pedagogical material at all education levels
Bans AI as a school performance assessment tool
AI platforms only optional research support requested by teachers, never mandatory
Teacher supervision of AI outputs to prevent algorithmic discrimination
Ministry of Education must ensure secure, trustworthy AI with privacy by design
